say:1:1322469001:1.text: This... This is from Lev, my friend.

picture:2::2.source_cn: 名为《轻松掌握咕咕语》的书籍

say:3:1322469003:1.text: I... I can't bear to look at it. Could... could you... read it for me?
say:3:1322469003:1.source_cn: 伊琳娜不敢看……能……拜托……你们……读给我。

document:5:159:0.text:
Month ?? Day ??
I ended up in a place called Cedartown. My legs were frostbitten, and no one seemed to notice me. I hadn't eaten in days.
When I was about to pass out, a girl brought me water and food. She even lit a fire to keep me warm.
Her name was Irina.

Month ?? Day ??
Irina and I became friends. She has trouble speaking and comes across as cold, but I can tell she's kind and wants to connect with people.

Month ?? Day ??
She took care of me until my fever broke and I got my strength back. I don't know how to thank her, so I sang for her.

Month ?? Day ??
I met someone strange who told me about the Great Will. If it's real, maybe it can help me repay Irina and heal her speech.

Month ?? Day ??
The acolyte told me that the ritual can heal Irina. If that's true, I'll pay any price to have her healed...
document:5:159:0.source_cn:
■月■日，我来到一个叫雪松镇的地方，我的腿被冻伤了，没人注意到自己，我已经快四天没吃东西了。
当我意识模糊时，一个女孩送来了水和食物，还生了火。
她叫伊琳娜。

■月■日，伊琳娜和我成为了朋友，她讲话有障碍，虽然脸上表情冷冷的，但我发现她内心很温柔，渴望与他人沟通。

■月■日，在伊琳娜的照顾下，我恢复了一些体力，烧也退了，我不知道该怎么报答她，只能为她唱歌。

■月■日，我接触到一个神秘的人，他向我告知了伟大意志的存在，也许我可以通过伟大意志来报答伊琳娜，治好她的口疾。

■月■日，传教士大人告诉我，在祭祀上就可以获得治愈伊琳娜的方法，只要他们说的是真的，无论什么代价我愿意承受。

say:7:1322469005:0.text: *Sobbing* Lev... Lev... what happened to him...
say:7:1322469005:0.source_cn: 呜呜……列夫哥哥……列夫哥哥他……

say:8:1322469004:0.text: "The priest told me that the ritual can heal Irina... If that's true, I'll pay any price to have her healed..."
say:8:1322469004:0.source_cn: “传教士大人告诉我，在祭祀上就可以获得治愈伊琳娜的方法...

say:9:1322469006:0.text: Does this mean... I'll never... see him again?

choice_prompt:10:1322469003.text: I... I can't bear to look at it. Could... could you... read it for me?
choice_prompt:10:1322469003.source_cn: 伊琳娜不敢看……能……拜托……你们……读给我。

say:14:1322469010:1.text: Irina, Lev used to sing to you, didn't he?
say:14:1322469010:1.source_cn: 伊琳娜，列夫曾给你唱过歌，对吗？

say:16:1322469012:1.text: It might be a bit too much to ask, but... would you be willing to sing one of the songs he used to sing to you?
say:16:1322469012:1.source_cn: 也许有些让你有些为难，但你能为我唱一首列夫唱过的歌吗？

say:18:1322469014:1.text: I know, but I think it's worth a try.
say:18:1322469014:1.source_cn: 我知道，但我希望伊琳娜试一试。

say:20:1322469016:1.text: The wind and snow... the child of wind and snow, we wait for you to come home.
say:20:1322469016:1.source_cn: 风和雪……风和雪的孩子啊，我们在等你回家。

say:21:1322469017:1.text: Here, there's hot food and mama. Here, flowers bloom for you.
say:21:1322469017:1.source_cn: 这里有热腾腾的料理和妈妈，这里有为你盛开的花。

say:22:1322469018:1.text: The child of wind and snow, we wait for you to come home.
say:22:1322469018:1.source_cn: 风和雪的孩子啊，我们在等你回家。

say:23:1322469019:1.text: You've gone to a place I can't see. Please, come back to us soon.
say:23:1322469019:1.source_cn: 你飘到了我看不到的地方，所以请你快些回答。

say:24:1322469020:1.text: The child of wind and snow, are you still wandering out there?
say:24:1322469020:1.source_cn: 风和雪的孩子啊，你还在外面流浪吗？

say:25:1322469021:1.text: On your way home, don't be lonely, don't be afraid.
say:25:1322469021:1.source_cn: 归来的路上，不要孤独，不要害怕。

say:27:1322469022:2.text: Wow! I'm getting a little teary-eyed here! That was beautiful!
say:27:1322469022:2.source_cn: 哇！我听完鼻子酸酸的！唱得真好！

choice_prompt:28:1322469022.text: Wow! I'm getting a little teary-eyed here! That was beautiful!
choice_prompt:28:1322469022.source_cn: 哇！我听完鼻子酸酸的！唱得真好！

say:29:1322469023:0.text: I'm really moved, too... I had no idea Irina could sing so well!
say:29:1322469023:0.source_cn: 虽然我也很感动……但是伊琳娜竟然唱歌这么流畅？

say:31:1322469026:1.text: Just like I thought, some of the children at the temple have a speech condition similar to Irina's. We've been trying to teach them hymns to help them speak properly again.
say:31:1322469026:1.source_cn: 果然应验了我的猜测，圣堂中有一些孩子和伊琳娜有相似的口...

say:32:1322469027:1.text: It's not easy. Some of them can't even get the first song right, no matter how hard they try.
say:32:1322469027:1.source_cn: 他们学唱歌非常艰难，有些孩子无论怎么努力都无法学会第一首歌。

say:33:1322469028:1.text: But some of them... after practicing for a while, they start speaking like they never had a problem.
say:33:1322469028:1.source_cn: 但也有不少孩子通过练习歌曲，最后可以恢复到像正常人一样讲话。

say:35:1322469029:0.text: So, in a way, Lev really did cure Irina, didn't he?!
say:35:1322469029:0.source_cn: 这么说！列夫真的治好了伊琳娜！

say:36:1322469030:1.text: In a way, yes. Irina... would you come back with me to the temple?
say:36:1322469030:1.source_cn: 某种意义上是的，伊琳娜，你愿意跟我回圣堂吗？

say:37:1322469031:1.text: I... I don't want to be a burden...

say:38:1322469032:1.text: Irina, your song moved me so deeply. This isn't out of pity. It's a genuine invitation.
say:38:1322469032:1.source_cn: 你刚才的歌声很令我感动，这一切并不是处于对你的怜悯，这...

say:39:1322469033:1.text: Irina, you almost made me cry with that song! You've got an amazing voice!
say:39:1322469033:1.source_cn: 伊琳娜，我刚才都差点被你唱哭啦！你的歌声真的很好听！

say:41:1322469034:1.text: That's right! So please say yes!

say:44:1322469036:0.text: It was like telling a story! Almost had me in tears!
say:44:1322469036:0.source_cn: 是的！像是叙述着一个故事一般！非常感动！

say:45:1322469037:1.text: Well... I... I'll give it a try...

say:47:1322469039:3.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll take Irina to talk to her father about this.
say:47:1322469039:3.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll take Irina to talk to her father about this.
say:47:1322469039:3.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll take Irina to talk to her father about this.

say:48:1322469040:1.text: Don't worry, I've already spoken to him, and I know how to convince him.
say:48:1322469040:1.source_cn: 你放心，我和她父亲接触过了，我有办法说服他。
say:48:1322469040:1.male: Don't worry, I've already spoken to him, and I know how to convince him.
say:48:1322469040:1.female: Don't worry, I've already spoken to him, and I know how to convince him.

say:52:1322469044:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... thank you... thank you so much.
say:52:1322469044:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... thank you... thank you so much.
